# The Living Indexes

> The Living Indexes: a source-backed catalog published by Kymata Labs.

Snapshot collected: 2026-11-11T17:15:18.981759+00:00
Current catalog records: 17

## Sources and interpretation

- [Published sibling index snapshots](https://indexes.kymatalabs.com/)
- [Collection and scoring source](https://github.com/tekvisions/living-indexes/blob/main/build_data.py)

This hub reads each sibling data.json and links to its own methodology. GitHub-discovery directories, commit-velocity trackers, the official MCP registry directory and Hugging Face Model Radar use different signals. Counts sum catalog records rather than unique products across the fleet; unknown sibling counts are omitted from the sum.

<!-- Kymata discovery capabilities -->
## Mission and scope
Kymata Labs makes open-source AI tools, models and infrastructure easier to understand through focused, source-backed indexes. We publish dated source signals, explain ranking methods and limitations, and separate advertising from ranking and inclusion.

Find your way through open-source AI. Seventeen focused indexes connect the tools, models and infrastructure behind your next project.

## Supported capabilities
- Browse the 17 topic indexes in four groups
- Search index names and descriptions locally in the browser; raw search text is not sent by these controls.
- Filter indexes by topic group
- Read source references, snapshot dates, methodology, selection guidance and evidence limits.

## Evidence limits
- Snapshot signals are not proof of quality, safety, license suitability or fitness for a project. Verify upstream sources before adoption.
- Search and filters are browser controls; this description does not advertise a remote search API or an MCP endpoint.
- Crawl permission and machine-readable descriptions do not guarantee crawling, indexing, ranking or AI citation.
- Hub totals summarize dated upstream snapshots, can overlap, and are not a current complete fleet census. Consult per-index coverage notes.

- [Machine-readable capabilities, resources and dated coverage](https://indexes.kymatalabs.com/capabilities.json)
- The capabilities document uses Kymata's descriptive format; it is not a standard agent tool protocol.
